author: claude
summary: Closes huggingface_voice_upload plan tasks 002 (export bundle missing icon/README) and 003 (upload flattened structure, non-atomic), then wires the frontend so a user can actually publish a voice to Hugging Face: a Settings token field and a real Publish flow replacing a disabled placeholder pill in Voice Lab. Task 004 (engine-asset inclusion) remains untouched, owner-gated.

files.change: export_hf_voice_bundle() gains icon_bytes param; now writes README.md (via bundles.generate_readme_md, local import) and icon.png (when provided) into the export zip, both additive/optional. When sample_mp3_bytes is non-empty but voice_manifest lacks samples[], synthesizes a {path, primary} entry into both the written voice.json and the README input so the on-Hub manifest and its own widget block agree. HFHubClientProtocol.upload_files and HFHubClient.upload_files signature changed files: list[Path] -> folder_path: Path; implementation switched from N sequential upload_file() calls (path_in_repo=name, flattening structure) + a best-effort ModelCard tag-push fallback, to one HfApi.upload_folder() call (one atomic commit, structure preserved), repo_type='model' now explicit on both create_repo and upload_folder. upload_voice_to_hub's folder_path param renamed/passthrough, log line updated.

export_hub_voice reads icon.png (contained_path-checked) when present and passes icon_bytes through. upload_hub_voice no longer builds a flattened loose_files list -- passes extract_dir straight to upload_voice_to_hub.

New 'Publishing' section: a Hugging Face access token field (password input + Save/Clear button) posting to POST /api/settings, matching the existing _SECRET_FIELDS redaction pattern (real value never round-trips; a 'Configured' badge shown when settings.huggingface_token === '***').
Settings gains huggingface_token?: string (redacted sentinel, documented as such).
New component. Repo-id input -> api.uploadHfVoice -> success state (Hub link + commit id) or error state (422/502 message surfaced verbatim, e.g. 'no token configured').

Replaced the disabled/decorative 'Publish to Hugging Face ... planned' pill with a real button opening PublishToHuggingFaceModal. The backend (POST /api/voices/huggingface/upload) and frontend API client (api.uploadHfVoice) already existed and worked -- only the UI trigger was missing.

tests_added: tests/domain/test_voice_huggingface.py -- updated zip-structure test to expect the synthesized samples[] + README.md; new tests for icon inclusion, README reflecting manifest fields, and the widget-block-without-manifest-samples gap; FakeHFHubClient.upload_files and the token-handling test updated to the folder_path signature.
tests/domain/test_voice_huggingface_client.py -- TestHFHubClientUpload rewritten for upload_folder (mock swap, ModelCard patches removed, ValueError-path tests updated to the new signature).

tests/api/test_api_voices_huggingface.py -- FakeHFHubClient + the upload-endpoint test updated to assert folder_path contents (including the nested samples/preview.mp3 path, pinning structure preservation) instead of flattened basenames.

frontend/tests/unit/pages/Settings/components/GeneralSettingsPanelHfToken.test.tsx -- new, 5 cases (configured/not-configured display, Save posts JSON, Clear posts empty string, onRefresh + input reset on success).

frontend/tests/unit/pages/VoiceLab/PublishToHuggingFaceModal.test.tsx -- new, 6 cases (closed renders nothing, open renders form, success state with link+commit id, 422 error surfaced verbatim, Publish disabled until input, Cancel calls onClose).
frontend/tests/unit/pages/VoiceLab/VoiceLabPage.test.tsx -- new case confirming the real button (not the old placeholder) opens the publish dialog.
revert_checked: Both task 002's and task 003's new/updated tests confirmed red against the pre-fix code (git stash of app/domain/voices/huggingface.py + app/api/routers/voices_huggingface.py), then green after unstash -- 8 failures across the three HF test files on the stashed version, 0 after restoring.
verified_live: Confirmed against the real running backend: (1) POST /api/voices/huggingface/upload with no token configured returns 422 'No Hugging Face access token is configured...' before any network call; (2) POST /api/voices/huggingface/export for a real installed voice with an uploaded icon produced a zip containing voice.json, samples/preview.mp3, README.md, and icon.png (previously only the first two); (3) the Settings token field saves via a real POST /api/settings round-trip and the response redacts it to '***', never echoing the real value.
known_gap_flagged_not_fixed: VoiceLabPage crashes for every voice in this dev environment due to a pre-existing <SamplesSection> error (confirmed pre-existing by reverting this session's VoiceLabPage.tsx changes and reproducing the same crash) -- blocks live click-through verification of the new Publish button, though it is exercised by an automated test that mocks SamplesSection out. Flagged as a background task, not fixed here (out of scope).
